title: Which Psalm Speaks To You?
subtitle: Eight psalms, eight seasons of the soul

questions.text: What's the loudest thing in your chest right now?

options.text: Bone-tired and need to be led, not pushed.
Guilt that won't loosen its grip.
Fear of what's coming.
Loneliness — I want to be known.

questions.text: What posture does your prayer life take this season?

options.text: Lying down in green pastures.
On my face, begging mercy.
Curled up under God's wing.
Sitting still and finally quiet.

questions.text: Pick the line your soul keeps repeating:

options.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet.
I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills.
The Lord is my light and my salvation.
Be still, and know that I am God.

questions.text: When you need God most, you most want Him to be...

options.text: My shepherd.
My hiding place.
The one who knows me.
My help.

questions.text: Pick the verse you'd want tattooed on your bones:

options.text: I shall not want.
Create in me a clean heart.
I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
My help cometh from the Lord.

questions.text: When you can't sleep, your brain is...

options.text: Replaying what I did wrong.
Spinning over what might go wrong.
Reaching for a word, any word, from God.
Refusing to settle.
In a green field with nothing to prove.
In the secret place behind a closed door.
In silence I finally allow myself to keep.
In the word — open on my lap.

questions.text: What is your heart asking for this week?

options.text: Forgiveness and a clean start.
Direction — light on this next step.
Courage to stop being afraid.
To be fully seen and still loved.

psalm-23.name: Psalm 23 — The Shepherd's Psalm
psalm-23.description: You need to be led, not driven. God is gently asking you to lie down in green pastures and stop performing — He'll restore what's been depleted.

psalm-51.name: Psalm 51 — The Repentance Psalm
psalm-51.description: You're aware of where you've fallen, and you're not making excuses. The good news is that God specializes in clean hearts and renewed spirits — He's already running toward you.

psalm-91.name: Psalm 91 — The Hiding Place
psalm-91.description: You need a hiding place, and there is one. Underneath everything you're walking through is the shadow of the Almighty — He covers you while you can't cover yourself.

psalm-139.name: Psalm 139 — The Searched Psalm
psalm-139.description: You long to be fully known and still wanted. You are — every dark corner, every hidden joy. He searched you and stayed.

psalm-119.name: Psalm 119 — The Word Lover
psalm-119.description: You're hungry for the Word like it's bread. You need direction, and God puts a lamp on the very next step — that's all you have to walk by.

psalm-121.name: Psalm 121 — The Lifted Eyes
psalm-121.description: You're looking for help in the right direction. The Maker of heaven and earth is your keeper — He doesn't slumber, He doesn't drift, He doesn't quit.

psalm-27.name: Psalm 27 — The Courage Psalm
psalm-27.description: Fear is on the table, but it's not the loudest thing in the room. The Lord is your light — and once you see Him, the room you were scared of starts to feel smaller.

psalm-46.name: Psalm 46 — Be Still
psalm-46.description: You don't need a strategy — you need stillness. God is louder when you stop. Be still, and let Him be God for a minute.
